findings.problem: The hint rules out tan and multi-word options like así que, but pues is also one word that means 'so' when drawing a conclusion or moving on ('Pues, ¿vienes o no?'), and it is very common in Mexico and Colombia, so the prompt has two right answers.
findings.fix: hint: one word, to draw a conclusion or move on, not pues or tan

back.es: then, so (adverb: at that time; or, as a connector, in that case / so)
back.example: So, are you coming or not?

note: This card stays clearly separate from the word's other card, "then" (at that time).
